display.purpose: Hero headings only. One per page.

body.purpose: Primary reading text. Line length capped at 65-75ch.

shadows.name: hover-subtle
shadows.purpose: Subtle hover state for interactive cards.

shadows.name: dropdown
shadows.purpose: Floating dropdown panels and select menus.

motion.name: stagger-default
motion.purpose: Stagger delay between child items in a list.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button. Terracotta background, white text. Used for login, upload, save.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 4px 16px; background: #E66239; color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: filter 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(230, 98, 57, 0.25); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent with 1px border. Used for Cancel, Download.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 4px 16px; background: transparent; color: #262626; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f5f5f5; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(230, 98, 57, 0.25); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text input field. Compact 32px height, 8px radius.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 32px; min-width: 0; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 14px; color: #262626; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: 8px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #737373; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #E66239; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(230, 98, 57, 0.15); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; background: #f5f5f5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card Container
components.description: Content card. 12px radius, 1px border, no shadow at rest.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; background: #ffffff; } .ds-card-content { font-size: 14px; color: #262626; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Sidebar tree navigation item. Hover and active states use Terracotta.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(38, 38, 38, 0.8); border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #E66239; background: rgba(230, 98, 57, 0.1); } .ds-nav-item.active { color: #E66239; background: rgba(230, 98, 57, 0.1); font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Select Dropdown
components.description: Custom select dropdown with fixed-positioned panel.
components.css: .ds-select-trigger { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; color: #262626; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-select-trigger:focus { border-color: #E66239; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(230, 98, 57, 0.15); } .ds-select-label { color: #737373; } .ds-select-chevron { color: #737373; transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-select-trigger[aria-expanded="true"] .ds-select-chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }

narrative.overview:
The interface of a special collections reading room: calm, orderly, and deliberately backgrounded. Every surface is flat and matter-of-fact. Borders, not shadows, separate content regions. The typography is clean and legible — Geist with Noto Sans Thai for Thai-language support. The single accent, Terracotta, is used sparingly: buttons, links, active navigation states. Its rarity is the point.

This system explicitly rejects the visual language of corporate SaaS dashboards: no rainbow-colored stat cards, no glassmorphism, no gradient text, no heavy drop shadows. The design never competes with the documents it exists to surface.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces with 1px borders for hierarchy
Single restrained accent (Terracotta, used on <10% of any screen)
Dark mode achieved through tonal inversion, not hue shifts

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: Terracotta occupies no more than 10% of any given screen. If a layout requires more visual weight, use weight or spacing before reaching for color.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: No competing typefaces. Geist covers display, body, and UI. Mono is Geist Mono. Thai content uses Noto Sans Thai with matching proportions.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, focus), and only at minimum perceptible intensity. The one exception: floating dropdown panels that must visually escape their trigger.

dos: Do use Terracotta sparingly — buttons, active nav, links. Let the neutral palette carry 90%+ of the surface.
Do use 1px borders for surface separation instead of shadows. Flat is the default.
Do use text-wrap: balance on headings and text-wrap: pretty on prose paragraphs.
Do prefer the compact height (32px) for buttons and inputs as the default.
Do test every screen in both light and dark mode before shipping.
donts: Don't use rainbow-colored stat cards with per-item gradients.
Don't combine border: 1px solid with box-shadow blur ≥ 16px on the same element.
Don't use border-radius larger than 12px on cards or 8px on buttons/inputs.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, or side-stripe borders of any kind.
Don't use the hero-metric template (big number + small label + gradient accent).
Don't use <4.5:1 contrast for body text or 4.5:1 for placeholder text.
